documented_exceptions.reason: the repository has a single accepted collaborator; requiring a non-author approval would hard-lock main rather than strengthen it, and naming that collaborator in CODEOWNERS would record an independent-review control that does not exist
documented_exceptions.compensating_controls: seven required green contexts each pinned to the GitHub Actions app that may satisfy it, enforce_admins, strict up-to-date branches, required conversation resolution, and linear history apply to every merge including the administrator's
documented_exceptions.retires_when: a second accepted reviewer identity exists; then raise required_approving_review_count to 1, add CODEOWNERS, and update this policy in the same change
